page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8is-8x.32xlarge is a dedicated GPU-accelerated server instance designed for computationally intensive parallel processing tasks. Running on the KVM hypervisor with an x86_64 architecture, this instance integrates 128 dedicated vCPUs driven by Intel Xeon 6462C processors clocked at 3.3 GHz. The compute tier is backed by 1024 GB of system memory, providing an allocation ratio of 8 GB per core to handle large in-memory data structures alongside multi-threaded execution pipelines.

Acceleration is anchored by eight NVIDIA L20 GPUs based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, providing 384 GB of total video RAM distributed across 48 GB per graphics processor. High-throughput data movement between external storage and cluster nodes is supported by a 100 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. A notable architectural consideration is the absence of local storage, requiring persistent workloads to rely entirely on external or network-attached block storage architectures.

From an operational standpoint, bundling eight enterprise-grade accelerators with high host memory density delivers significant compute throughput per virtual instance, eliminating multi-node coordination overhead for workloads that fit within a single host. However, the reliance on external storage requires consideration of network I/O pathways for data transfer. The hardware configuration makes this server fit for large-scale AI inference, distributed model fine-tuning, high-throughput video processing, and graphics virtualization workloads.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8is-8x.32xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual instance engineered for intensive compute and machine learning tasks. Built on x86_64 architecture under the KVM hypervisor, it features 128 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 6462C processors running at 3.3 GHz, paired with 1024 GB of system RAM at an 8 GB per core ratio. Acceleration is delivered via eight NVIDIA L20 Ada Lovelace GPUs providing an aggregated 384 GB of VRAM. Inter-system communication is maintained by a 100 Gbps baseline network interface. The instance includes no onboard local storage, necessitating network-attached storage solutions for persistent data. This density of accelerator capacity and host memory optimizes processing efficiency by minimizing inter-node latency for complex parallel routines. The configuration is primarily targeted at distributed deep learning inference, model fine-tuning, complex data analytics pipelines, and dense graphical compute workloads.
